purpose: A fail-closed arithmetic kernel for the ten-stem/twelve-branch sexagenary cycle, the two-hour shichen partition, and the observatory-attested stem lookup tables. It supplies no day-count anchor, no year/month/day/hour boundary convention, no five-element tally, no Ten-God relation, and no interpretation.

source_anchors.location: Hong Kong Observatory public reference page, inspected 2026-07-31
source_anchors.verified_claim: Lists the ten stems and twelve branches in order, the complete sexagenary pairing beginning with Jia-Zi, the twelve two-hour shichen including Zi from 23:00 through 01:00, and year-stem-to-month-stem and day-stem-to-hour-stem lookup tables.
Defines solar terms as moments when the Sun reaches 24 predefined ecliptic-longitude positions and distinguishes twelve major and twelve minor terms.

source_anchors.location: Chinese Wikisource transcription of juan 1, inspected 2026-07-31
source_anchors.verified_claim: Volume one exposes stem-branch origins and the sixty-Jiazi enumeration as classical structural material. Transcription-grade witness only; it controls no wording.

cycle.parity_rule: Stems and branches advance together by one position per unit; only same-parity stem/branch pairs occur, giving 60 of the 120 combinatorial pairs.

month_stem_from_year_stem.description: HKO year-stem-to-month-stem lookup: the stem of the first (Yin) month determined by the year stem; subsequent month stems advance by one per month branch.

hour_stem_from_day_stem.description: HKO day-stem-to-hour-stem lookup: the stem of the Zi hour determined by the day stem; subsequent hour stems advance by one per branch.

solar_terms.definition: Moments when the Sun reaches 24 predefined ecliptic-longitude positions, as stated by the inspected Hong Kong Observatory table.
not_encoded: Per-term longitude assignments and names, pending capture of multi-year observatory tables.
Any mapping from terms to pillar-month boundaries, which is a school convention.

anchor_contract.supported_date_input: An ISO civil date already resolved under the named calendar policy and day-boundary profile of the anchor.
unsupported_inputs: A clock instant requiring unresolved timezone, solar-time, or day-boundary conversion
An unnamed or default day-count anchor
A day concordance asserted without a registered source

unresolved_boundaries: year boundary: beginning-of-spring term versus lunar/civil new year
month boundary: minor-term mapping and time standard
day boundary: civil midnight versus early/late Zi-hour rollover
hour clock: standard civil time, local mean solar time, or apparent solar time
convention_contract.policy: Any pillar assignment that depends on one of these boundaries fails closed unless a named convention profile resolves every boundary it touches. No default may be hidden from a report or cache key.

remaining_gates: Register a named day-count concordance source and encode two-sided boundary vectors against it.
Name a school convention profile resolving year, month, day, and hour boundaries with source authority.
Attribute a true-solar-time and historical-time policy with lineage and uncertainty.
Cross-check pillar output against independent observatory/almanac tables for multiple years.
Keep Ten-God, hidden-stem, and interpretation layers in separate, source-controlled packs.
